recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大量中等大小的淋巴樣細胞為主，核圓至卵圓、部分有凹陷，染色質細緻，淡藍色細胞質量中等且邊緣呈不規則的毛邊狀突起，與周邊血中的毛狀細胞相似。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei, some indented, with finely clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, frayed, fine hair-like margins
Few scattered small mature lymphocytes; normal hematopoietic precursors sparse in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and dominated by medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, frayed hair-like borders. Normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field and no blasts are seen. The cells resemble the circulating hairy cells, and findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia. Because aspirates in hairy cell leukemia are often a dry tap owing to reticulin fibrosis, the core biopsy with immunohistochemistry remains essential.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have irregular nuclei but scant cytoplasm without hairy projections and show CD5 and strong cyclin D1 expression.
SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and polar villi and are CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
HCL-variant cells show prominent central nucleoli and are CD25 negative.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles.
